title: Grateful Dead Live at Shoreline Amphitheatre on 1990-06-16
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > KORG AudioGate 4 > Samplitude Pro X4 Suite > FLAC/24
source: Ultra Matrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-X90)

ai_review.summary: Excellent ultra‑matrix recording of a high‑energy 1990 show featuring standout Truckin’, China and Terrapin Station jams
ai_review.review: The reviewer hails this 1990 performance as one of the greatest ever, highlighting inventive set choices like opening with Truckin’ and an expansive China/Rider jam, plus a memorable post‑Terrapin improvisation. The ultra‑matrix source captures the band’s adventurous energy with clear, listenable sound, making it a prized addition to any Deadhead collection.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed 5‑star review praises both the musical performance and the recording, leading to a high rating despite limited data points.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific complaints; ultra‑matrix source generally provides clear, balanced sound with audience ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewer notes creative set ordering and extended jams (e.g., China/Rider jam, post‑Terrapin improvisation) that kept the energy high and the pacing adventurous.
